name: tModLoader mod
summary: A Terraria mod for tModLoader, laid out like the one its own Create Mod button makes.
description: The source folder of a tModLoader mod: build.txt, the Mod class, an example item and its localization. It has to live in tModLoader's ModSources folder, because the project imports a file tModLoader keeps there and tModLoader builds mods from there.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Without spaces it becomes the folder, the namespace and the mod's internal name, which must never change once people use the mod. Mod, ModLoader and tModLoader are taken.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.
options.help: Shown in the game's mod list (description.txt).

options.label: Example item
options.help: A sword with a recipe, to see something in game straight away.

options.label: Item name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits and spaces only

next: Move the {{ProjectName}} folder into Documents\My Games\Terraria\tModLoader\ModSources (keep the folder name).
If ModSources does not exist yet: start tModLoader once and open Workshop, Develop Mods.
In tModLoader open Workshop, Develop Mods and press Build + Reload next to {{ProjectName}}.
The mod is now in the Mods list and enabled. Look for its line in tModLoader-Logs\client.log.
Your code starts in {{ProjectName}}.cs; the example item is in Content\Items.
